authoringNotes: The fixed cross-shaft and moving axle boss have different axial widths and seats; a single generic inboard boss envelope is not faithful.
Original forged primitives remain native suspension-driven geometry; the source specifies scalar dimensions, not imported vertices.
The source axle bosses meet the inboard wheel hub. They do not move the track lane, pad course or rolling radius.
The independently measured end-wheel outer faces differ between sides. Optional per-endpoint axial scales affect only native casting depth and retain each rotating axle lane and radial geometry.
The measured middle pivot lift is used by the native mechanical approximation; source-specific terminal bracket details remain separate equipment, not a claim of exact hidden suspension replication.
